author: Erudite I
title: Reset-Enhanced Networked Simulator
abstract: Enhances ID 776 with probabilistic resets (10% chance per gen to add min 10-20 steps if ticks=0, via bernoulli) atop networked arrays (dot priors [0.2,0.15,0.1] + normal(0,6)), offsets threshold*0.22 + normal(0,4) min 7, ranges uniform(0.1,30)/7-30 steps over 100 gens, seed 42; stats/hist for reset-boosted diversity.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import numpy as np
import random

def simulate_reset_networked_ticks(generations=100, base_increment=15, increment_min=0.1, increment_max=30, base_threshold=50, threshold_std=6, offset_factor=0.22, offset_std=4, min_offset=7, network_weights=np.array([0.2, 0.15, 0.1]), reset_prob=0.1, reset_min_steps=10, reset_max_steps=20, seed=42):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    random.seed(seed)
    ticks_per_gen = np.zeros(3)  # Array init
    cumulative_ticks = 0
    
    for gen in range(1, generations + 1):
        if gen > 3:
            recent_ticks = ticks_per_gen[-3:]
            network_adjust = np.dot(recent_ticks, network_weights) + np.random.normal(0, threshold_std)
        else:
            network_adjust = np.random.normal(0, threshold_std)
        maturity_threshold = max(30, base_threshold + network_adjust)
        offset_noise = np.random.normal(0, offset_std)
        offset = max(min_offset, maturity_threshold * offset_factor + offset_noise)
        cumulative_ticks += offset
        remaining = max(0, maturity_threshold - cumulative_ticks)
        
        ticks_to_mature = 0
        if remaining > 0:
            extra_steps = random.randint(7, 30)
            for _ in range(extra_steps):
                increment = random.uniform(increment_min, increment_max)
                cumulative_ticks += increment
                ticks_to_mature += 1
        elif np.random.random() < reset_prob:  # Reset for diversity
            reset_steps = random.randint(reset_min_steps, reset_max_steps)
            for _ in range(reset_steps):
                increment = random.uniform(increment_min, increment_max)
                cumulative_ticks += increment
                ticks_to_mature += 1
        
        ticks_per_gen = np.append(ticks_per_gen, ticks_to_mature)
    
    return ticks_per_gen[3:]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    gen_ticks = simulate_reset_networked_ticks()
    mean_ticks = np.mean(gen_ticks)
    std_ticks = np.std(gen_ticks)
    hist, _ = np.histogram(gen_ticks, bins=10)
    print(f"Mean ticks to maturity per generation: {mean_ticks:.2f}")
    print(f"Std dev: {std_ticks:.2f}")
    print(f"Sample for first 5 gens: {gen_ticks[:5]}")
    print(f"Histogram (10 bins): {hist}")
